model.title: Satellite Cybersecurity Act of 2025
model.meta: Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee · Sen. Gary Peters (D-MI)

summary.text: The bill would require the federal government to prepare a report examining what support and resources it currently provides to help protect commercial satellite systems from cyberattacks. It aims to assess the government's role in satellite cybersecurity and identify potential gaps or improvements needed in this area.
